description.value: Rice Holic is a specialty dessert stall operating in Richmond food courts, known for its signature Mango Mochi — fresh, hand-picked mangoes wrapped in soft, chewy mochi and produced in limited daily quantities. It occupies two food-court locations in Richmond (Empire Centre and Admiralty Centre), making it a convenient sweet stop for cyclists moving through the city's commercial corridor. Orders are available for online pre-order and in-person pickup only; no delivery is offered.
